asw.settings: asw serve, GET /route?from=lat,lon&to=lat,lon with defaults (shore_buffer=0, canals open, Arctic closed)

searoute-py.settings: searoute(origin, destination, units='naut', append_orig_dest=True), default restrictions (Northwest Passage closed)

searoute-ts.settings: seaRoute(origin, destination, {network: marnet-20km, appendOriginDestination: true, units: 'nauticalmiles'})

eurostat.settings: java -jar searoute-jar-3.6.jar -i in.csv -o out.geojson -res 5 -kiel 1 -corinth 1 (5 km network, the finest; Kiel and Corinth opened to match asw; other passages at their defaults, Northwest and Northeast passages closed)
eurostat.batch_note: 45 routes in one run: 9.1 s, 19.5 s and 17.3 s in three runs; one route alone: 1.4 to 1.6 s (JVM start and network build)

arcnautical.settings: findOceanPath(fromLat, fromLon, toLat, toLon), defaults; route cache cleared before every call

method.osm_skips: nothing; OSM water polygons count as water inside the Panama and Kiel canal boxes
method.compared: only lines with no land on the way (OSM check)
